stage2_cell_format.description: Stage 2 will publish one adjustment cell per (position, tier) per source, fitted against the Monday reassessed methodology leg (the same fit universe the current baked *_adjusted fixture sections were fitted against). Each cell is an affine map from the source's as-published fixture value to its adjusted value.

cell_fields.position: QB | RB | WR | TE. The *_adjusted sources cover QB/RB/WR/TE only (no K/DST).
cell_fields.tier: starter | bench. Waiver-tier players are never adjusted; the fixed-pie normalization still zeroes them.
cell_fields.alpha: number. Intercept of the affine map.
cell_fields.beta: number. Slope on the published value.

fail_closed_rules: Players with no matching (position, tier) cell keep their as-published value (no adjustment).
Cells with an unknown position, a tier other than starter/bench, or non-finite alpha/beta are ignored.
The browser applies cells to the fixture raw refs (the as-published combos), then runs the same normalizeTradeChartToFixedPie / applyRosterShape treatment as the baked path.

live_refit_recipe.description: The browser refits every eligible (source, position, tier) cell live from the fixture ESPN projections whenever the bench share or league config changes. Stage 1 refits for inspection but still renders the exact inherited fallback branch (no baked cells -> no display change).
live_refit_recipe.independent_input: The source's as-published fixture value for the active scoring/teams combo.
live_refit_recipe.target: The live two-tier value: the full-precision two-tier value at the active bench share (marginal rates solved per position against the frozen pool lines) times the single shared 70/max(raw) scale. Rounding is display-only and never enters the fit.
live_refit_recipe.method: Ordinary least squares per (source, position, tier): beta = cov(published, target) / var(published); alpha = mean(target) - beta * mean(published).
live_refit_recipe.tiers: starter | bench from the two-tier model's own starter/bench partition (flex starters count as starters). Waiver-tier players are never adjusted; the fixed-pie normalization still zeroes them.
live_refit_recipe.eligibility: A cell is emitted only with >= 2 finite (published, target) pairs and positive published-value variance; otherwise no cell is emitted and players keep their as-published value.
fail_closed: Positions whose calibration is invalid at the active share (starter rate <= bench rate) are withheld from the fit: no cells, no targets, values priced at zero.
Cells with non-finite alpha/beta are dropped.
The per-position fail-closed guard in the 2x2 solve stays as a backstop behind the bounded slider.
live_refit_recipe.slider: One global bounded slider writes the same bench share to all skill positions (each position falls back to the shared default); K/DST are excluded. Bounds are the maximal contiguous feasible interval containing 0.15, rounded inward so endpoints stay strictly feasible; the current value clamps if a config change moves it outside. Recommended tick at 0.15 with a reset affordance.

notes: Stage 1 is architecture staging only: every source has status pending-stage2 and an empty cells list, so the dashboard falls back exactly to current behavior (baked *_adjusted fixture sections for fantasycalc/usatoday/fantasypros, browser-derived buildCbsAdjustedMap for cbs).
Repo source of truth: data/adjustment-inputs/adjustment-inputs-<version>.json. Served copy: app/trade-value-chart/assets/adjustment-inputs.json.
